title: [tenmin-backfill] tenMinPairManifestKey: characterization test for the two-month pair manifest key
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for tenMinPairManifestKey in src/tenmin-backfill.ts: pair manifest keys
- tenMinPairManifestKey("2024-10-15") is "permanent/tenmin-reply-dust/2024-09-01_2024-10-31/manifest.json"
- tenMinPairManifestKey("2024-01-01") is "permanent/tenmin-reply-dust/2024-01-01_2024-02-29/manifest.json"
- tenMinPairManifestKey("bad") throws INVALID_SESSION_DATE

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v2): Peace's task (source: peace). The R2 manifest key for a two-month ten-minute pair (built through tenmin-history's pairRangeForDate) and its INVALID_SESSION_DATE guard have no test anywhere; this pins its current behaviour. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 5c41528 (Workspace main efd3f76, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v2); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with tenMinPairManifestKey stubbed); suite 564/564 with all eight new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
